brief: wave-1 piece W1-00 - Harness, determinism and persistence
outputs_written: game/data/** (33 files) incl. save-manifest.json, states/, combat/movesets|enemies|input, world/, npcs/, dialogue/, quests/, items/, books/, progression/
findings: HARNESS.md S3 is the API contract; tools/lib/run.mjs REQUIRED_METHODS = setSeed, stepFrames, queueInputs, snapshot, traceStart, traceStop.

tools/lib/run.mjs drives: setSeed -> loadState(scenario.state) OR reset({seed}) -> setTimeOfDay/setWeather -> setup ops -> stepFrames(warmup) -> queueInputs -> traceStart -> stepFrames(chunk) + traceDrain loop -> traceStop. Game must match this order exactly.

Judging items demand harness amendments A-JRN1,3,5,6,7,8,10,11,15 (JOURNEY-CRITIC-FLEET.md S7). Without them RI-JRN03/05, RI-PLT01/03 are all 'unmeasurable = 0'. Implementing them is in scope and is the difference between 0 and a score.
RI-CAM06 requires a `camera` trace block incl. shake, mode, hitstop, roll; camera must be updated INSIDE the fixed step.
RI-PLT01 Tier-H (fps, frame times) is NOT scoreable in this container (SwiftShader). Tier-S = drawCalls, triangles, programs, materials, alloc/step, sim CPU, decoupling.

RI-JRN05: IndexedDB authoritative; localStorage banned except <=1KB pointer; write protocol = one readwrite txn over [blobs,saves,meta]; monotonic generation; A/B double buffer; digest check with gen-1 fallback.
three.js 0.180.0 vendored to game/vendor/three/ (three.module.js + three.core.js + LICENSE). npm IS reachable.
viewpoints.json anchors needed: vista_primary, swamp_canopy, settlement_primary_street, interior_firelit, water_shallows, npc_showcase, material_showcase, dungeon_primary, arena_flat.
corpus/50-world/regions.json holds 13 real regions - transcribe, do not invent.
next_step: A different fresh reviewer-editor must re-criticise the r6 material expansion of the W1-00 RI-MTH07 census and consumer/control contract.
notes_for_successor: Evidence lives in reports/runs/{DETERMINISM,API-PROBE,SAVE-AUDIT,INPUT-PROBE,SHOTS} and reports/platform/TIER-S. Known open items: (1) RI-MTH02 R5 fails on two enemy fields that are warm-up-dependent by construction - amendment AM-W1-00-01 filed, NOT applied; (2) alloc/step is measured with performance.memory, which is coarse - a CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage probe (A-JRN9) is the stronger instrument and belongs to the runner; (3) pointer-lock checks M-K8..M-K11 need a real user gesture and a menu surface (W1-21); (4) enemy AI is deliberately absent - inf_trash declares ai='hold_ground' and never attacks, so cmb-duel-infantry's punish statistics are structurally 0.
plan_review_outcome: Material r6 reviewer edit: expanded RI-MTH07 from exported harness models to every relevant shipped or harness-derived model and tightened actual-consumer and non-inert world-delta requirements.
next_plan_step: A different fresh reviewer-editor must re-criticise the materially edited r6 plan; do not build.
